raw_text: URGENT: All Sikh brothers and sisters in diaspora must unite for the referendum. Canada venue confirmed. UK venue being finalized. Australia coordinators needed. India is pressuring host governments to shut us down. We will not be silenced. Forward this message to 10 Sikh families today. Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa.
clean_text: Diaspora United Telegram channel coordinated referendum logistics across Canada, UK, and Australia while claiming Indian government pressure on host nations to suppress the events.
